about: Yardstick of scripts/links_issue.py, read live by `python3 scripts/links_issue.py --sample tests/links-sample.json`. Real addresses with and without the defect looked for, each with the verdict expected when it was read. check = globalping: a link that failed from the machines of GitHub, opened again from 3 probes (down: broken; alive: it blocks GitHub; tls: the secure connection is refused by the checkers). check = page: the page is opened and judged (healthy, parked or expired, taken over, closed). An expected list accepts any of its verdicts. A site can change: a mismatch is read before the script is changed.
